newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines' ATM consortia to link up in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' ATM consortia to link up in 1997.

text.p: Two consortia of banks offering automated teller machine (ATM) services in the Philippines have signed a memorandum of agreement to interconnect starting next year, officials of the ATM groups said on Tuesday.
Megalink chairman Tirso Antiporda said the interconnection will make the electronic banking services of 30 banks accessible to their combined six million cardholders.
Under the merger, customers of either Megalink or ExpressNet can access 1,500 ATM stations, of which 754 are in the provinces and 223 are off-branch stations.

ExpressNet official Aurelio Montinola said the participation of BancNet, another consortium which has an existing interconnection deal with Megalink, is not yet being discussed since the groups would concentrate on the interconnection of Megalink and ExpressNet.
"This linkage is not the last transformation bank customers will see. We in the banking sector see greater alliances ahead," Antiporda said after the signing ceremonies.
